event.title: SFSCON '26 - "Automating translation of a bestseller to spark children’s interest in coding" in Bolzano, Italy in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: The story “Ada & Zangemann – A Tale of Software, Skateboards and Raspberry Ice Cream” is inspiring many kids, teens, parents and many others to learn programming and shape technology.

The free culture license of the book enables and compels the community to adapt it, and they have. Since its release it has been translated into 38 languages, published as a book in 7 and as movie in 5. And it is available in a growing number of other formats: epub, online book, bilingual book and kamishibai. By leveraging open standards (XML, Docbook, ITS) and Free Software (Scribus, itstool, gettext, xsltproc, pandoc, Weblate) we created automation that enables translators to add new languages while also enabling new formats to be added.

In this presentation, Nico Rikken will tell the story how the automation developed over time, and share the inspiring stories from the community that leveraged the automation and influenced its development.
The talk will be in English and it will take place in the Seminar 3.
